note: Curated premium typography system for Karim/Calaf — quality over volume (NOT 1000 random pairings, by design). Keyed by brief type. Honors the default-fonts ban.

pairings.name: Editorial New + Aktiv Grotesk
pairings.heading: PP Editorial New
pairings.notes: Literary serif display against a neutral Swiss grotesque reads intelligent, not bombastic. Mono scoped to model/version meta labels.

pairings.name: Reckless + PP Neue Montreal
pairings.heading: Reckless Neue
pairings.notes: High-contrast modern serif + clean geometric grotesque; the default-ban-safe alternative to the Cormorant/Inter autopick.

pairings.name: Fraunces + Authentic Sans
pairings.heading: Fraunces (variable SOFT/WONK)
pairings.notes: Fraunces opsz/SOFT axes give warmth without nostalgia; canonical luxury-editorial pick from the ban doc.

pairings.name: Bricolage Grotesque + Inter Tight
pairings.heading: Bricolage Grotesque
pairings.notes: Bricolage adds character to product chrome; Inter Tight (NOT plain Inter) keeps dense tables legible. Geist Mono for stats/IDs.

pairings.name: Geist + Geist Mono
pairings.heading: Geist
pairings.notes: Vercel's single-family system; mono as display accent is sanctioned. Clean, modern, zero banned faces.

pairings.name: Switzer + IBM Plex Mono
pairings.heading: Switzer
pairings.notes: Switzer is the unbanned geometric workhorse that replaces Outfit/DM Sans; pairs with IBM Plex Mono for code panels.

pairings.name: Clash Display + Plus Jakarta Sans
pairings.heading: Clash Display
pairings.notes: Clash carries expressive hero weight; Space Mono gives telemetry character without the JetBrains cliché. From the soft-skill approved set.

pairings.name: Syne + PP Neue Montreal
pairings.heading: Syne
pairings.notes: Syne's quirky display range suits studio/agency creative-tech; Montreal anchors body. Earns its variety per the ban doc.

pairings.name: Migra + Authentic Sans
pairings.heading: Migra
pairings.notes: Brutalist/cultural-leaning contrast serif + raw grotesque; scope ALL-CAPS to eyebrows only.

pairings.name: Canela + PP Neue Montreal
pairings.heading: Canela
pairings.notes: The dark-site replacement for Playfair; Canela light needs the -0.02em + ≥300 anchor to avoid spindle, per the orbit-general fix.

pairings.name: GT Super + Aktiv Grotesk
pairings.heading: GT Super Display
pairings.notes: GT Super gives gallery-grade display weight; mono used sparingly for captions/credits.

pairings.name: Domaine Display + Switzer
pairings.heading: Domaine Display
pairings.notes: Domaine's editorial luxury without Cormorant overexposure; Switzer keeps body modern and ban-safe.

pairings.name: Instrument Serif + Inter Tight
pairings.heading: Instrument Serif
pairings.notes: The promotable taste-editorial triad verbatim: serif display / grotesque body / mono meta. Reference-grade role separation.

pairings.name: Newsreader + Switzer
pairings.heading: Newsreader
pairings.notes: Newsreader's opsz axis is built for long-form; 55-70 char measure, max-width 65ch. The literary register without Cormorant.

pairings.name: Lyon Text + PP Neue Montreal
pairings.heading: Lyon Text
pairings.notes: From minimalist-skill: tight -0.02em to -0.04em tracking, 1.1 leading. Premium editorial benchmark.

pairings.name: DM Serif Display + Libre Baskerville
pairings.heading: DM Serif Display
pairings.notes: The sanctioned replacement for the Cormorant-bearing zhangzara editorial decks. High-contrast literary voice, free, ban-compliant.

pairings.name: IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Plus Jakarta Sans
pairings.heading: Plus Jakarta Sans (Latin) / IBM Plex Sans Arabic
pairings.notes: The rtl-arabic-i18n default pairing. Apply :lang(ar){font-size:1.075em}. Never track Arabic. Never Noto Kufi.

pairings.name: El Messiri + Cairo
pairings.heading: El Messiri
pairings.notes: El Messiri display Kufi for headlines, Cairo (Karim's existing sites) for body. From the ban doc's MENA pool. Tracking 0 mandatory.

pairings.name: Amiri Display + Tajawal
pairings.heading: Amiri
pairings.notes: Amiri Naskh serif for editorial/literary Arabic; Tajawal friendly-marketing body. Min 16px Arabic floor; per-block direction.

pairings.name: Druk Wide Bold + IBM Plex Mono
pairings.heading: Druk Wide Bold
pairings.notes: The papaya-smoke-hero racing pattern, generalized: compressed/wide display earns ALL-CAPS in-context. Mono scoped to HUD/telemetry only — NOT JetBrains.
